name: Thalorien at the Sunwell gate

date.label: During the Third War, as the Scourge reached Quel’Thalas; exact date unknown

summary: When the Scourge reached Quel’Thalas, Thalorien held the approach before the Sunwell. He fell in that defense, buying time for those behind him; the quest’s memory binds his name to the blade he carried. The golden island was not spared its wound, and the champion was not carried into the future. His stand belongs to the Third War, long before this Wrath quest asks another hand to restore his sword.
